title: pellaea woodfordii
intro: Pellaea woodfordii, commonly known as Wood's fern, is a species of fern in the family Woodsiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Pellaea woodfordii are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for its health benefits are thought to include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to confirm the exact mechanisms of action.
